historyAvailability: Opening Split and Last 25 Changes for all five. First Full Split is present for four; absent for UTEP/Oklahoma.
timestampMeaning: History scrapedAt/sourceObservedAt comes from the actual source row month/day and ET clock. Year 2026 follows the requested event code; America/New_York handles timezone. Current page has retrieval timestamp only. Retrieval is recorded separately for each response.
marketLimitations: VSiN history supplies spread and total lines and moneyline prices, but does not supply spread or total juice. Those four price fields remain null; no AN prices attached to VSiN history.
zeros: Numeric 0 percentages are preserved only where printed by VSiN. Missing lines/prices remain null. An opening split can have ML only and no spread/total.
observationLimit: Last 25 Changes is a source-limited sample, not a complete timeline. No interpolation or invented observations.
circaModelReference: Original selected VSiN Circa 2026-09-04 17:50 ET Book vs Model snapshot remains separate and unchanged.
